evidence.observation: Reboiler reads ~417-420 °C, physically implausible and >330 °C above the next stage (T702 ~84 °C); drifts slowly upward with no effect on column profile
Column profile stable/plausible (84 °C down to ~68 °C), top stages slowly cooling — consistent with normal operation
Reflux ~0.22-0.43 L/h and distillate ~0.31-0.64 L/h, with FYI702 jumping between ~2.7 and ~3.9, inconsistent with the measured flow ratio (FT703/FT704 <1)

args.missing_evidence: An independent reboiler temperature reading (or heater duty/setpoint) to confirm T701 sensor fault, and a distillate composition (GC) measurement; also clarification of how FYI702 is computed relative to FT703/FT704.
